summary: Amphenol filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that its two-for-one stock split by stock dividend was effected on September 2, 2026, with a record date of August 17, 2026. Accordingly, the previously announced third-quarter dividend of $0.25 per share, payable October 14, 2026 to shareholders of record September 22, 2026, is adjusted to $0.125 per share post-split. This is a routine corporate event, not a special situation. No offer, transaction, or strategic action is involved. Watch for subsequent dividend declarations adjusting to the new share count.
